newsitem.title: CHINA: China mulls int bond issues for state firms.
newsitem.headline: China mulls int bond issues for state firms.

text.p: China is considering allowing large state-owned companies to issue bonds on international markets, the China Daily said on Wednesday.

Overseas issues by firms in strategic sectors that had good credit histories would give them access to longer term and cheaper credit and would encourage better management, the official newspaper said.
Currently, China only permitted 13 financial institutions to issue bonds abroad, although some of the funds raised had been used by important enterprises and in vital construction projects, it said.

Beijing would examine the qualifications of authorised issuers annually and would gradually give state-owned firms the right to issue bonds overseas, it quoted officials as saying. It gave no timetable.
